title: Ella Langley to Perform Intimate SiriusXM Small Stage Series Show in Denver
summary: The country star will perform hits, fan favorites, and songs from her latest album, “Dandelion,” at The Grizzly Rose.
body_markdown:
[Ella Langley](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/ella-langley) is bringing her music to an intimate stage in Denver for a special SiriusXM performance that will air on[The Highway](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/the-highway) .


[The Highway (Ch. 56) Country’s next generation Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogEllaLangleySSS-TheHighway)


The country star will take the stage at The Grizzly Rose on Tuesday, October 6, for[SiriusXM’s Small Stage Series](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/small-stage-series) , presented by REESE’S.


The exclusive concert will feature Ella performing her hits, fan favorites, and songs from her[latest album, “Dandelion.”](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/ella-langley-dandelion-lyrics-meaning)


### **How to Listen to Ella Langley’s Small Stage Series Concert**


Can’t make it to Denver? SiriusXM listeners across North America can hear Ella’s full performance on The Highway (Ch. 56) on Friday, October 9 at 8pm ET.


The concert will also be available to listen to anytime on the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogEllaLangleySSS-TheHighway) .


- **Related:[Miranda Lambert Opens Up About Her Friendship with Ella Langley](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/miranda-lambert-kacey-musgraves-reunion)**


### **How to Get Tickets to Ella Langley’s Denver Concert**


SiriusXM subscribers and fans can enter for a chance to win a pair of tickets to the show presented by REESE’S – click[HERE](https://www.siriusxm.com/ellalangleytixOL) for full details. If you do not live in the Denver area, you can also enter for your chance to win a VIP trip to the concert – click[HERE](https://hotline.web-cloud.siriusxm.com/ella-langley) for full details. At the show REESE’S will treat fans to a flavorful on-site experience with exclusive surprises, giveaways and product sampling.


### **SiriusXM’s Small Stage Series**


Launched in 2021, SiriusXM’s Small Stage Series brings major artists to intimate, iconic venues for exclusive performances.


Previous Small Stage Series performers include Alicia Keys, Brandi Carlile, Coldplay, Dave Matthews, Ed Sheeran, Green Day, H.E.R., Hilary Duff, J Balvin, J. Cole, Jason Aldean, Kane Brown, Kenny Chesney, Lainey Wilson, and more.
